title: Resume-on-unpaused wedges the eval loop (LOOP: paused) — proven 2026-09-06 fleet-wide 30-min stall
description: BUG: loop.go pause/resume share ONE channel (pauseCh chan bool). Fleet sat with evaluation_age climbing (no ticks) 15:31:20->16:02:17 CT (~31 min) while /api/v1/status reported paused=null and the deployer believed scheduling was resumed (HTTP 200). Recovered by POSTing resume a SECOND time (inner select received true -> 'LOOP: resumed'). FIX: state-track pause (bool+mutex); Resume() no-ops when not paused, Pause() no-ops when already paused; or make the handler idempotent. SCHED-GAP-090's restart wrapper must NOT POST resume after a restart (fresh daemon boots unpaused) unless it first confirmed the daemon is paused.
